text: Residents of Woodycrest Avenue between Sammon Avenue and Mortimer Avenue have voted in favour of speed hump installation. These traffic calming measures would enhance safe traffic flow for residents.

The Toronto and East York Community Council: 1. Authorized the installation of traffic calming (speed humps) on Woodycrest Avenue between Sammon Avenue and Mortimer Avenue. 2. Directed the City Solicitor to prepare a by-law to alter the roadway to install four speed humps on Woodycrest Avenue between Sammon Avenue and Mortimer Avenue, generally as shown on shown on Attachment 1 to the letter (January 9, 2025) from Councillor Paula Fletcher.
